forum.title: STM32N6: Missing LTDC Layer 0 parameter - Color Frame Buffer Start Address
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Pantomime

This issue has been fixed in the latest version of STM32CubeMX 6.18.0

Download STM32CubeMX6.18.0 from  [here](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
When configuring the LTDC Layer Settings for an STM32N6 chip in CubeMX, the *Layer 0 - Color Frame Buffer Start Address* is missing:

![Pantomime_0-1777624318293.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/12aad403-e4ed-e44d-ad78-68f8a810fae8.png "Pantomime_0-1777624318293.png")

This parameter is available with other chips, such as STM32F750:

![Pantomime_1-1777624465485.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/4d548b7f-9c0d-ba48-8b37-6e7cf48c4a96.png "Pantomime_1-1777624465485.png")
forum.author: Pantomime

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @Pantomime 

Your contribution is much appreciated.

I confirm this GUI limitation on STM32N6: the LTDC Layer Settings do not show the “Layer 0 - Color Frame Buffer Start Address” field, although the generated code still includes FBStartAdress.

A ticket #0062332 has been escalated to dev team for resolution.

I will keep you posted with updates.

 

Thx

Ghofrane
